Whenever I play KOTOR or KOTOR II, I typically stick to the same two characters throughout the entire game. Rather than focus on combat expertise (as I'm sure many do), I really take on the RPG aspect of the game and choose the two I'd most likely go with or would have the best back-and-forth banter. How do you play?
Who do you pick for your party in both games?

For me, I always pick Carth and Bastila in KOTOR. That isn't to say that I don't love the other characters, but Carth and Bastila just "felt" like the right composition for me. They always had great dialogue between each other too.

For KOTOR II, it's a similar case: Atton and Kreia. They are more or less the Carth and Bastila of this game and for the same reasons. Atton and Kreia have some of the most hilarious arguments in any game I've played. Always a fun time playing with them.

I also tend to use two or three different companions each playthroughs but i tend to switch between playthroughs what companions i use. However my favorites would probably be Kreia and Visas from kotor 2.
Two of the best KOTOR II characters without a doubt. Kreia always intrigued me with her mystery and cynicism, and I always felt a close bond to Visas for some reason.
I always used all characters as often as possible because I didn't want to lose any optional dialogue or partymember sidequests.
I agree that using all characters are the most optimal, i feel kotor 2 rewarded you even more for using most of your companions because the jedi/sith system!

For a lot of games where I pick my party members, usually I stick with two or three.

But with KOTOR and KOTOR 2, for some reason I also manage to cycle all my companions through. They all have such unique dialogue and things of the sort.

I take Jolee and Canderous in KOTOR I, but for battles (Jolee has good powers and Canderous kicks ass with close-ranged weapons)
Before I looked up the stats, I took bastilla (because, we have a connection between us, right?) and mostly carth (original team! yay!) or HK-47 because I found him funny
For a time I took Mission and Z, but I didn't like Z and I felt like if I took Mission I had to take Z too, they belong together
